name: Mino Ceramic Co., Ltd.
summary: Mino Ceramic Co., Ltd., formed in 1918 with headquarters in Nagoya, Japan, develops, makes and distributes advanced ceramics and refractory products. Its refractories include shaped bricks such as basic, clay-based, high-alumina and alumina-silica types, as well as monolithic refractory products for harsh industrial environments. It also supplies materials for floor coatings used in factories, offices, public institutions and railway facilities.
